To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the superconducting coil composed of YBCO coated conductors has generated a magnetic field up to 0,65T at 65K in zero external magnetic filed and the critical current of the multi-tap YBCO conductor that is formed of two tapes has practically reached the sum of the two tapes.
a YBCO coil has been fabricated and tested.
we have developed a new method to fabricate YBCO coils and multi-tape conductors, which have the potential to improve the capability for transporting current.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the YBCO coil with high critical current and high critical magnetic field.
the development of the superconducting coil for the application of the superconductivity.
the fabrication and testing of YBCO coated conductors and multi-tape YBa2Cu3O7-δ conductors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the YBCO conductor and coil can generate a large magnetic field and transport a large amount of current at a relatively high temperature, and that the YBC0 conductor can be easily fabricated into a coil by a simple process.
the superconducting behavior and the magnetic field properties of the YBCO coated conductors are promising.
the YBCO coated conductors have the potential of being used in a wide range of applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the critical current of the YBCO coil is limited by the current transport of the conductor and the critical current of multi-tape conductor is determined by the critical current of each tape.
the critical current of a multi-tape conductor has been successfully enhanced by a factor of 2.5.
we have succeeded in the fabrication of a YBCO coil and a multi-tape YBaCuO conductor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the critical current of a YBCO tape is not degraded by the bundling of two tapes.
the critical current of YBCOs can be increased by increasing the number of tapes.
the critical current of YBCOs can be improved by bundling two YBCO tapes.
